issue-278.title: Reserve priority for inbound control replies
issue-278.change: src/http/websocket.cj separates the reserved reply slot from the caller writer and close slots. Pong and the Close reply use replyWaiting, a caller close frame uses closeWaiting, and the application writer yields both slots before taking the active writer. closeWithContext reserves reader admission before writing any close frame, so a rejected third caller is side-effect free.

issue-279.title: Defer completion until the rejected response is wrapped
issue-279.change: src/http/client.cj executeDuplex wraps the rejected response and retains its lifetime before emitting RequestCompleted/Succeeded. A cancellation that wins the wrap reaches the single failure path, so one logical request emits exactly one terminal event.

issue-280.title: Preserve the stop error when abort cleanup fails
issue-280.change: src/internal/connector/happy_eyeballs.cj isolates the literal abort failure in connectLiteral, keeps the cleanup exception as the cause and still throws the canonical Cancelled/TimedOut Connect-category exception, which drives the existing failed attempt event.

issue-281.title: Restore the cancellation once-gate regression tests
